about.title: About the app
about.description: eGovAI is a desktop app that helps public servants work with an AI assistant in Vietnamese. In one workspace you can discuss your documents with the assistant, draft text, and schedule recurring tasks.
about.mission: Help Vietnamese speakers, especially local government staff, use AI in their own language for everyday work so they have more time for tasks that call for their expertise and judgment.
about.documentGoal: Support drafting and reviewing Vietnamese documents, with particular attention to the language of public administration.
about.workflowGoal: Reduce repetitive steps when compiling materials, preparing reports, and tracking tasks.
about.reviewGoal: Make it easier to check drafts against source documents before using them.
